about: The shape of one distribution: its values counted into bins that touch along a numeric axis. The ticks are the bin edges, and the tooltip heads each bar with its range.

clipped.about: domain bins a range from its lower edge and leaves out the values outside it, so the bins narrow to the body of the distribution. Here the bins are 5ms wide.
clipped.caption: In bins 5ms wide, the peak is at 30 to 40ms. The 5 requests over 150ms are left out.
clipped.title: Clipped range

coarse.about: bins aims for a number of bins, and the width snaps to a round number. Six bins of 100ms put 131 of 140 requests in the first bin, and the shape of the body is gone.
coarse.caption: In bins 100ms wide, 131 of 140 requests fall in the first bin.
coarse.title: Fewer bins

latency.about: The response times of 140 requests in bins 20ms wide, Freedman–Diaconis' count snapped to a round width. The values are raw numbers, not rows, and valueOptions writes the edges in milliseconds.
latency.caption: 107 of 140 requests finish under 60ms, and a slow tail runs to 460ms.
latency.label: Response times of the checkout API
latency.title: Response times

narrow.about: The response times in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. The labels keep their even step of 100ms.
narrow.title: Narrow room

orders.about: Sixty order values in euros, the bars in the teal palette's chart color. countLabel names the counts in the tooltip.
orders.caption: Two in three orders come to less than €60, and six pass €100.
orders.label: Order values this week
orders.title: Order values

peak.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at a bin when the chart first renders. The heading is the bin's range and the row its count.
peak.caption: 54 of 140 requests take 20 to 40ms, the tallest bin.
peak.title: Tooltip

quiet.about: A histogram without a finite value renders the empty state in the plot's place, at the plot's ratio.
quiet.caption: Response times of the checkout API this hour.
quiet.title: Empty

replay.about: animate grows each bar from the axis when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the bars at once.
replay.title: Animation

title: Histogram
